# ConvertKDP — Free Format Converters

> Time zone, unit, and temperature converters. Instant, no signup, runs in your browser.

## Converters

- [Time Zone Converter](https://convert.kdp.cool/time-zone-converter/): convert between 80+ IANA time zones with DST handling, using browser-native Intl.DateTimeFormat.
- [Unit Converter](https://convert.kdp.cool/unit-converter/): length, weight, volume, area — metric ↔ imperial.
- [Temperature Converter](https://convert.kdp.cool/temperature-converter/): Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin with formula explanation.
